spec.situation_desc: transferred money to someone pretending to be from the bank

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Priya speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi. I'm Callum Okonkwo. I transferred money to someone pretending to be from your bank, and I'm really unhappy with how this has been handled.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'm sorry this has happened, Callum. I can hear how frustrating it is. Before we discuss anything about your account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that's verified. Can you tell me a little about what happened?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Someone called saying they were from Thistle's fraud team and told me to move my money to a safe account. I sent £2,400. I contacted the bank afterwards, but I don't feel anyone's taken responsibility.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'm sorry you've been left feeling that way. I'll take ownership of this and I'm logging it as a complaint about the scam and how we've handled your report. The reference is TB-64182.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'll make sure the complaint team has the details you've given me, and I'll personally contact you by Wednesday 28 October with an update on the review. I can't promise what the outcome will be.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You'll also receive a full written response within 15 business days. That response will explain what we've looked into and our decision.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay, so you'll call me by Wednesday with an update, and I'll get the full response within 15 business days?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That's right. I'll contact you by Wednesday 28 October, and the complaint team will send the full written response within 15 business days. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You're welcome, Callum. I'm sorry you've had to deal with this, and I'll make sure the follow-up happens.
